column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Moze's Trial at Demon Strait
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: My name is $$モーゼ$$, a $$邪道騎士$$.
I am the one who guides $$さまよえる民$$ to the $$約束の地$$!
(A $$邪道騎士$$ like me?)
Perhaps...
I alone am the guidepost that will unravel your questions.
Then you know the location of the $$総本山$$,
even the cause of the earthquake just now?!
Truth is entrusted to the strength of your will...
What?!
But why?
Judging by those horns, you too were once a $$神官$$ with black $$羽$$!
Why reveal this to us?
Because I have come to be certain you are the $$さまよえる民$$ I must guide.
I watched your actions in $$ソドムとゴモラ$$.
In that situation, your decision might be called right in a sense.
To bring change to the $$世界$$, one must explore many possibilities.
But whether you are equal to that answer...
I want you to show me. Will you?
Oh! Test us as much as you like!
Once this battle begins, you cannot flee until the very last enemy is defeated.
Fine by me! Who would run away?!
$$さまよえる民$$ who serve the $$血$$ Covenant, answer my question now!
